reason: Consequence of tokens-group-island-focus-ring (tokens.json): the [role=group] and [role=search] focus ring inside a nested data-theme island whose scheme differs from the page uses the island's scheme color instead of the page's. 2.1.1 fixed the ring color in the root's scheme; light-dark() resolves it per element.
notes: Seed from PLAN. Narrowed in Phase 1: any element carrying data-theme other than the root (the seed only matched div), and only the states that focus a control inside the group (hover never does). Review round 2 pinned both values to the single-ring shape (a color, three zero offsets and a spread in px).
